tagline: Zeiss Ikon盒式相机，1926 年发布
description: The Balilla is a box camera for 4.5x6cm exposures, made by Zeiss Ikon for supply to the Italian Fascist boys' club, the Opera Nazionale Balilla (active 1926-37), named after a Genoese boy who supposedly began a revolt against Austro-Hungarian occupation of Genoa in the eighteenth century.
